parse.title: Mind Bloom
parse.wikitext:
{{Event Header|Event-MindBloom.png}} {{E|Mind Bloom}} is an [[Event]] found exclusively in [[Act 3]]. It is one of the events affected by {{Asc|15|Ascension}}. ==Options== {{Frame|I am War}} {{TS|negative||Fight a [[Bosses#Act 1 Bosses|Boss]] from Act 1.}} {{TS|positive||Obtain a {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Rare|Rare}} [[Relic]].}} * The boss is selected at random. It can be the same boss that the player actually fought in [[Act 1]], or one of the two that they did not encounter. * In addition to the Boss dropping a {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Rare|Rare}} [[Relic]], it also drops normal combat rewards and 50 {{Asc|15|(25)}} [[Gold]].
{{Frame|I am Awake}} {{TS|positive||[[Upgrade]] all cards.}} {{TS|negative||You can no longer heal.}} * Obtain {{R|Mark of the Bloom}}.
{{Frame|I am Rich}} {{TS|positive||Gain 999 [[Gold]].}} {{TS|negative||Cursed - 2 {{C|Normality}}.}} * This option only appears on floors 35 to 40.
{{Frame|I am Healthy}} {{TS|positive||Heal to full HP.}} {{TS|negative||Cursed - {{C|Doubt}}.}} * This option replaces {{Frame|I am Rich}} on floor 41 and above. ==Dialogue==
While walking and traversing through the chaos of the Spire, your thoughts suddenly begin to feel very... {{TS|purple|up|real...}}
Imaginings of {{TS|red||monsters}} and {{TS|gold||riches}} begin to manifest themselves into reality.
The sensation is quickly fleeting. What do you do?


{{Frame|I am War}}
(No dialogue; the player immediately enters combat with the random [[Bosses#Act 1 Bosses|Boss from Act 1]])
{{Frame|I am Awake}}
Everything makes sense now.
The lack of memories, the ascent, the {{TS|gold||Ancient One.}}
This is the way it always was.
This is the way it always will be.
All will be forgotten again soon...
{{Frame|I am Rich}} or {{Frame|I am Healthy}}
Can it really be this easy?
==Notes== * Because the healing prevention of {{Frame|I am Awake}} is implemented as the {{R|Mark of the Bloom}} relic, it can disqualify the player from the [[Achievements|''Who Needs Relics?'' achievement]]. * The boss fight from {{Frame|I am War}} will trigger {{R|Pantograph}} and {{R|Slaver's Collar}} as if it were a normal end-of-Act boss fight. * {{R|Omamori}} can prevent one or both {{C|Normality}} curses from {{Frame|I am Rich}} if it has one or both uses remaining. This allows the player to receive 999 [[Gold]] with practically no downside, especially considering that {{E|Mind Bloom}} is often one of the last opportunities to encounter {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Curse|Curses}} in a run. ==Trivia== * The boss music that plays during the {{Frame|I am War}} fight is a slightly different version of the normal Act 1 Boss music (''The Guardian Emerges'') simply called ''Mind Bloom'' in the Slay the Spire Original Soundtrack. ==Update History== * '''Patch V1.1: The Dealer''' ** Bottled Cards upgraded from Mind Bloom event have their description updated correctly. * '''Weekly Patch 50: The Final Act''' ** Because new music was added into the game, it is now also available in our Official Soundtrack. Newly added tracks include: Mind Bloom * '''Weekly Patch 47: Metamorphosis''' ** Mind Bloom event combat now correctly gives appropriate gold for the battle. * '''Weekly Patch 43: Discovery''' ** Mind Bloom event now correctly shows curse previews for its event options. * '''Weekly Patch 42: Reboot''' ** Adding special BGM when fighting a boss via Mind Bloom event. * '''Weekly Patch 36: Power Through''' ** Fixed an incorrect interaction with Mark of the Bloom and the Moai Head event in Act 3. * '''Weekly Patch 35: Aggregate''' ** Mind Bloom event's boss battle no longer counts as a boss for scoring or achievements. * '''Weekly Patch 29: TURBO''' ** Mind Bloom no longer shows status/curse cards upgrading. ** Mind Bloom upgrade now only shows up to 20 cards as it's CPU intensive. * '''Weekly Patch 28: The Ritual''' ** New Act 3 event: Mind Bloom ** New Relic: Mark of the Bloom {{EventNav}} [[Category:Events]]
